Shipping Policy
Please carefully review our Shipping & Delivery Policy when buying products from White Feather Supplies. This policy will apply to any order you place on White Feather Supplies.
Shipping & Delivery
Welcome to the shipping policy of White Feather Supplies! We strive to provide all our customers with a seamless and efficient shipping process. This page outlines the important information regarding the shipping and delivery of White Feather products.
Shipping Methods
White Feather offers its prestigious customers various shipping methods. Once you put the desired items in your cart from White Feather Supplies, you will get the shipping options, shipping costs, and estimated delivery times at checkout. However, the shipping costs may vary depending on the geographical area and weight of the product.
Shipping Areas
White Feather Supplies currently ships its products to selected destinations. Please verify during the checkout process whether we deliver your to your location. If your desired location is not listed, we apologize for the inconvenience and hope to deliver to your location soon.
Order Processing Time
Once you place your order, we strive to process your order for shipment within 2 business days. However, there may be exceptions due to the peak season, promotional periods, or any unforeseen circumstances that delay the order processing.
Order Tracking
Once the order is processed and shipped to your destination, you will receive a confirmation email from White Feather Supplies containing a tracking number and instructions to follow to track your order. Use the tracking number in the email to track the progress of your order and check its estimated delivery date to avoid any inconvenience.
Delivery Time
Being a customer-first product seller, we strive our utmost best to provide you with accurate delivery estimates. Remember, the delivery time is calculated based on the shipping method and the destination. However, it is to be noted that the delivery may be delayed due to unforeseen circumstances which are not in our control. Unforeseen circumstances may arise due to customs procedures, delays caused by shipping carriers, etc.

Return & Exchange Policy
Effective Date:
07/10/2025
Return Window
Customers are entitled to request a return of items within thirty (30) days from the date of receipt. After thirty (30) days, return requests will not be accepted.
Eligibility for Return
To be eligible for a return, the item must be in its original, unused condition, with all original tags and packaging intact. Proof of purchase, such as the original receipt or order confirmation, is required. Items that have been opened, used, or altered in any way are not eligible for return.
Exclusions from Return Policy
Used Items
: Due to the nature of the product, items that have been used in any capacity, including but not limited to being worn, altered, or damaged by the customer, are ineligible for return.
Restocking Fees
: In the event that the return reason is other than a manufacturing defect, the buyer shall bear the cost of return shipping and may be subject to a restocking fee of up to twenty-five percent (25%) of the original purchase price.
Damaged Products
: If the product arrives damaged, the customer must notify
White Feather Supplies
within seventy-two (72) hours of receipt of the item. Failure to report damaged goods within the specified time frame will forfeit eligibility for return or refund.
Return Process
To initiate a return, the customer must contact White Feather Supplies at
whitefeathersupplies@gmail.com
.
to request a return authorization. The customer will be provided with instructions for returning the item and, where applicable, a return shipping label.
Returned items must be sent to the following address:
White Feather Supplies
3200 14th Street, Suite No 410
Plano, TX 75074
USA
Unauthorized Returns
Any returns sent to White Feather Supplies without prior authorization will not be accepted. Items must be returned in accordance with the return authorization instructions provided.
Refund Process
Once the returned item has been received and inspected, a refund will be processed to the original payment method, minus any applicable restocking fees and shipping costs as stated herein.
Contact Information
For any questions or concerns regarding this return policy, customers may contact White Feather Supplies at
whitefeathersupplies@gmail.com
.
